title: project.resource.export request
description: Turn one resource back into a file, from the project alone. `prepared_output`: `prepare` reports the plan and writes nothing, `commit_reviewed` re-derives it and writes only if the digest still matches. The project is named by the envelope's `project` locator.

resource.description: The resource to produce. Deliberately the only argument: the bytes, the recipe, the encoding and the destination are all already in the project, and a caller that could pass a width or an extension could produce a file the record claiming to reproduce it does not describe.
